title: Encode untrusted data for its output context
summary: Untrusted data rendered into HTML, attributes, URLs, scripts, or templates must use the context-appropriate safe rendering mechanism.
review_checks: Find raw HTML sinks and template escape bypasses.
Check whether data can come from users, stored content, or upstream APIs.
safe_tests: Use harmless local strings that exercise HTML and attribute escaping.
Confirm the rendered result is data rather than executable markup.
remediation: Prefer framework auto-escaping and safe DOM APIs.
Sanitize only when HTML is a deliberate feature and define a strict allowlist.
